string.value: SADF parachute infantry initial playable definition. Dedicated platoon HQ plus three ten-man sections (34 men) is a gameplay establishment, not a verified universal SADF TOE. Alexander, The Cassinga Raid (2003), PDF p.33 documents ten-man parachute sections in a two-section Hawk Group, not this full platoon. Existing SADF rifle/LMG statistics, personnel bindings and ammunition loads retained as proxies. R4 starts January 1981 following existing mod convention, not a proven parachute-specific issue month. Nutria/webgear art inherited; parachute-specific appearance and early-period suitability require review. No parachute-drop mechanic or helicopter embarkation acceptance implied. No automatic elite rating bonuses.

string.value: CU. Two bounded evidence snapshots ONLY: reportedCIR October1975 and named Cuban participant accounts for4May1978 nearTchamutete/Cassinga; NO continuous1975-1978service claim. AlfonsoRamonNaranjoRosabal,Tareas175(2023),printed105/PDF53 lists ZPU4 with480Cuban instructors arriving11October1975: moderate retrospective operator/deployment inference, not originalFARledger/namedfiringcrew. Granma,3May2018,El odio de los hombres que aman, quotes named Cuban gunner/loader testimonies describing14.5mm four-barrel pieces, three guns in one recalledplatoon and a separate AKM-armed command squad. ZPU4 family identification is an inference from the stated calibre/fourbarrels; precise production subtype/round mark unknown. Native1109 weapon40/ammo36/performance, five-men/600ready/2400reserve, two visible actors, 4man rifleHQ2112/three-gun19man group/radios are representative AB2 tactical allocations, not authenticated CubanTOE/ammunition issue. Existing national1975/1978 footpersonnel supportHQ; gunner/observer olivecaps/clothes/paint/skin/boots represent national style, not exact named-person kit or appearance. Complete ground1722gun+407gunner+371observer=2500; native-state travel1722; disabled shares groundshape with dedicated generated dark diffuse. Originalfourbarrels/12-sidedwheels/76face concave seat retained; minorhardware and complete hands/body details deliberately coarsened. Final four discrete pose diagnostics add no new crew/hardware component contacts; inherited seated-leg contacts remain. Hand sampled deviation peaks11.989mm;10mm simplifier target is not a rigorous surface bound. Only offline/native32 proof, no firing/movement/shader/terrain/engine or owner acceptance. Sources: https://www.granma.cu/cuba/2018-05-03/el-odio-de-los-hombres-que-aman-03-05-2018-19-05-38 and archived research/cuban_early_mixed_arms/tareas175-2023.pdf. Native-style roster restructure: Two existing teams/guns are a native tactical purchase allocation, not a newly authenticated national establishment or extra equipment date.

string.value: RHODESIA September-October1979 bounded Operation Miracle snapshot. Named John Wynne Hopkins retrospective wargaming reconstruction (29March2018) expressly lists MAP7.5 vehicles with RLI separately from RhA MAP7.5 towing tractors; this qualifies representative troopcarrier presence by late1979, not exact official convoy manifest or 12Troop identity (questionmarked in source). Named Locke/Cooke1995 printed54-56 supports standard open-top heavy capsule, 10mm mild steel and regular infantry use. Existing 2400-face national photo-led family art retained unchanged: six complete roadwheels and spare, cab and fixed hatches, open troop body. Exact Miracle serial/paint/hatch state unknown. Unarmed native transport representation, not historical assertion all MAP75 lacked mounted or passenger weapons; no unsupported roofgun added. Closed cab has no visible foreign driver; no exposed crew omitted. Existing national RLI FN/MAG infantry and HQ supplied through native carriers-first pairing. Native BTR152 donor handling/speed65kmh/offroad/survivability/visibility and simple10mm all-around armour are explicit gameplay approximations, not authenticated mild-steel ballistic equivalence, mine immunity or real MAP performance. No turret/top armour; no engine mineproof feature invented. Poster7.19x2.28x2.84m provisional art dimensions. Native menMax0/menToMove0 transport semantics retained; no passengerCapacity field or historical crew count inferred from those values. Mounted section8dismounts/patrol17/HQ5 and radios are AB2 tactical allocations, not actual Miracle30man troop establishment, maximum seating or proof radio issue. Existing national FN animations and normal weapon ammunition remain native proxies. Source https://johnwynnehopkins.wordpress.com/2018/03/29/operation-miracle-sept-oct-1979/ . Offline/native32 only; engine load/unload/movement/shader and owner acceptance untested.

string.value: RHODESIA September-October1979 Operation Miracle bounded snapshot. Named John Wynne Hopkins 29March2018 retrospective wargaming reconstruction explicitly lists MAP4.5 within RLI column block; moderate contextual family-use evidence, not authenticated manifest, exact serial or official establishment. Source https://johnwynnehopkins.wordpress.com/2018/03/29/operation-miracle-sept-oct-1979/ . Locke/Cooke1995 printed58 public OCR identifies cutdown MAP75 hull on4.5ton Mercedes LA911B with single rear wheels and shorter waist-high rear; baseline open unarmed troopcarrier is distinct from later roofed command modifications. Exact paint/fit and real armour thickness/dimensions/performance unqualified. All nominal10mm simple armour, BTR152-derived handling/speed65kmh/offroad/survivability/visibility are explicit native gameplay proxies copied from installed MAP75, not sourced MAP45 measurements or mild-steel ballistic equivalence. Native hull collision dimensions6.5x2.50x2.78m are provisional gameplay estimates enclosing the body/wheel envelope, excluding the final outward-leaned spare extremity. Final complete art bounds6.5x2.820875x2.780311m include that spare; body width2.24m. These are not factory dimensions or exact collision simulation; no hull armour hitbox enlargement is inferred from the spare. No mine immunity, roofgun, passengerCapacity or new transport mechanic invented. Native menMax0/menToMove0 semantics retained. Section8dismounts, two-carrier patrol17 and HQ5 with radios are AB2 tactical allocations, not historical maximum seating, official TOE or proof radio issue; source12soldier nominal rear capacity is not an engine-capacity assertion. Existing national RLI FN/MAG infantry and HQ use native carriers-first formations. Exact firstissue and continuous retention throughDecember1979 not asserted. Engine loading/unloading/movement/shader and owner acceptance untested.

string.value: MPLA/EPLA ordinary scouting January1965-July1974. Bounded initial armed-guerrilla role inference across existing early national infantry horizon, not a January1965 scout founding or direct observation claim. string.value: Early Ratel mechanized platoon. Combat Group Juliet used Ratel 20 infantry during Operation Reindeer in May 1978. Sources https://www.ajol.info/index.php/smsajms/article/download/89172/78726 p321 ; https://ditsong.org.za/en/the-ratel20-infantry-fighting-vehicle/ . Four existing Ratel carriers (1730) and four eight-man sections retain formation 3705 tactical allocation and radio fields. This is not an authenticated historical establishment. The existing R1/Bren section (2001) in 1978 and R1/MAG/captured RPG section (2232) in 1979-80 are representative national equipment cohorts, not unit-specific issue orders. Legacy formation 3037 remains unavailable. Vehicles, weapons, crews, artwork and statistics remain unchanged. Engine boarding and command behavior require owner testing.

string.name: comment
string.value: Cuban ordinary dismounted scout patrol, October1975-May1991. Initial instructor/combat-adviser cohort inference: Espinosa participant interview documents early Cabinda reconnaissance before the November invasion, and an explicit reconnaissance element in May1976. Mixed Cuban-Angolan context does not identify every scout nationality or prove a named independent establishment. Native58 four-man AK team and268 two-team section are tactical proxies, not archival strength/load. No special-forces title or elite/stealth/training/morale bonus. National faction-date personnel/models and all native effects retained. Continuous-deployment role retention to May1991; late1988 observation is not an introduction date. Source decision: research/initial_force_roles_v2/cuba/decision.json. No engine acceptance.

string.name: comment
string.value: Cuban sapper cohort, November1975-May1991. Initial combat-reinforcement inference: Espinosa documents Cuban help preparing Cabinda mines/obstacles before8November1975 and a sapper platoon with detectors in his May1976 mixed column; named participant Reynaldo Estrada dates UM1138 sapper arrival18November1975. His republication/comment are one witness, not independent corroboration; exact national monthly establishment is not asserted. Native560 seven-man AK sapper and927 three-team platoon are tactical representations, not archival strength, ammunition or charge-mark allocations. Native engineer/demolition effects unchanged; no detector/bridging mechanic, RPG upgrade or quality bonus. National models retained. Bounded role retention to May1991; late1987 observation is not an introduction date. Source decision: research/initial_force_roles_v2/cuba/decision.json. No engine acceptance.

string.value: FAPLA scouting continuity from existing EPLA scouts across August1974 reorganisation. Paulo de Almeida participant interview OPais6Dec2024 documents personally reconnoitring CIR Cazage in September1974 with Dangereux. string.name: comment
string.value: UNITA ordinary scouting March1966-October1975. Bounded initial guerrilla screening/security patrol allocation from Chinese-trained founding cadres, clandestine December1965-January1966 regional infiltration and active guerrilla operations. Party foundation history and participant MiguelNZauPuna interview corroborate trained1965cadres; these sources describe organisation, not a directMarch1966scoutmanifest. November1975participant recon account and June1977CIA observations are later corroboration, not introduction dates. https://unita-angola.co.ao/fundacao/ ; https://nai.uu.se/library/resources/liberation-africa/interviews/miguel-n%C2%B4zau-puna.html . Four-man team and two-team native268 reconnaissance section are tactical game allocations, not a named standing scout unit, exact monthly establishment or authenticated firearm mix. Complete existing early national bolt2/ball1 x60 proxy retained; no AK/grenade backdate, quality, elite, sniper, stealth, suppressed or extra spotting bonus. National faction/date infantry animation retained; no new art or weapon effects. No engine acceptance.

string.name: comment
string.value: RLI ordinary foot reconnaissance, January1976-December1979. Primary RLI Cheetah October1980 printed45 explicitly says Tracking Troop became Reconnaissance Troop in January1976 with additional reconnaissance roles. Earlier1965 Recce Troop was Ferret-equipped and ceased1974; do not backdate this foot purchase to1965. Two four-man FN patrols follow native268 tactical grouping; unit2441 complete FN3/ammo2x130 profile retained without quality, stealth, sniper or tracking bonus. Existing national faction-date moving infantry retained; no new personnel identity/model or authenticated uniform claim. This represents RLI scouts, not Selous Scouts or all RLI. Formation date anchors cohort availability; subsequent role retention toDecember1979, not first source observation. Source: research/initial_force_roles_v2/rhodesia/decision.json. No engine acceptance.

string.name: comment
string.value: Rhodesian unprotected Bedford RL personnel transport, January1965-December1979 bounded inherited fleet/cohort allocation. Cooke/Locke truck chapter describes RL as army stalwart since1960s; participant/regimental accounts identify RAR patrol deployment19May1972 and RR passenger loss7May1973, with later secondary-role retention. Start1965 follows established early-war fleet continuity, not first-found1972 report or exact delivery date. Reused installed covered rounded-cab RL-family body2495triangles with no external crew and unchanged native1414 technical/transport fields. Dedicated dark-matt-green/khaki texture is representative1965-66 finish with bounded older-fleet retention; precise paintcode, repaint month and particular hull are not claimed. No mine protection, Barber plates, armoured cab or later MAP capabilities. One existing national eight-man RAR section or five-manHQ per truck, fourtruck HQ+3section platoon and HQ+3platoon company are native tactical allocations, not official RhodesianTOE or maximum seatcapacity. Existing FN/MAG national loads/models unchanged; no gun or quality bonus. National animated infantry visual approximation remains inherited, not newly authenticated RAR personnel art. Source: research/initial_force_roles_v2/rhodesia/decision.json. No engine boarding, terrain, movement or shader acceptance.
